name: Armee Infotech Limited
industry: IT Infrastructure and Managed Services / Renewable Energy
description: We are an Ahmedabad-based IT infrastructure and managed services company, expanding into retail through Experience Zones and into renewable energy via solar EPC and PPA projects. We serve both government/PSU and private clients, with most revenue from PSUs. Our IT services include hardware/software supply, installation, integration, training, and maintenance.

objects.purpose: Expansion of business by procuring new Government/PSU projects
Prepayment or repayment of certain outstanding borrowings availed by our Company

top_risks: We depend significantly on orders from Government/PSU clients. As of March 31, 2025, more than 57.47% of revenue was recognized from Government/PSU clients.
We are dependent on our Technology Partners for hardware and software products. As of March 31, 2025, 77.96% of purchases were from our top three Technology Partners.
Most projects are awarded primarily through competitive bidding, and we may not always qualify for, compete, and win projects.
